$comment: Items of sform's command tree that only tests a target may lack the feature for ([RequiresFeature]) or that never run ([Skip]) cover (spec §4.2). Their tests exist and skip with the reason where Target:Features lacks the feature. CommandCoverageTests checks that every item covered only by such tests is listed here and that no entry is covered by a test that runs against every target. command: the path without sform; item: an option form, --option=value, argN or an alias (missing: the command itself); feature: of CliFeatures; reason: why. See docs/Platform/Cli.AutomationTests/automation-tests.md#coverage-exceptionsjson.
